stories.headline: XPeng unveils IRON humanoid robot, unified Turing Physical AI architecture and VLA 3.0, targeting mass production in January 2027
stories.summary: XPeng showed its IRON humanoid and Turing Physical AI architecture at AI Day, with mass production targeted for January 2027 and a store-assistant trial in Q1 2027. Sources differ on price: reports say it may sell near an EV's price, while Xinhua and others give no price.
stories.reason: covered by Reuters-adjacent wires, Bloomberg, Nikkei, Seeking Alpha, Yahoo Finance; multiple outlets across regions; primary source XPeng AI Day

stories.headline: Waymo faces passenger gun incident in San Francisco, California DMV ban on freeway rides, Denver egg attacks and federal investigation over school-bus passing
stories.summary: Waymo's freeway rides were halted after the California DMV barred driverless operation on freeways, citing safety incidents; a recall covering 4,488 units was reported. Separately a loaded gun was found in a San Francisco robotaxi, a Denver man repeatedly attacked Waymo cars, and US authorities are investigating school-bus passing.
stories.reason: widely covered by CBS, NBC, Reuters-derived reports, Mashable, Newsweek; regulatory action from California DMV

stories.headline: Nvidia forecasts more than $25 billion in physical AI revenue for fiscal 2027
stories.summary: Nvidia expects physical AI revenue to exceed $25 billion in fiscal 2027, reported by several outlets as roughly a quadrupling.
stories.reason: covered by multiple outlets; company guidance

stories.headline: EU delays vote on Tesla's Full Self-Driving approval to December 15; Tesla releases FSD v15 and expands Cybercab robotaxi fleet in Texas
stories.summary: The EU postponed its meeting on Tesla's assisted self-driving system to December 15. Tesla rolled out FSD v15 with interventions menu removed and reportedly expanded its Texas robotaxi roster past 1,000 Cybercabs.
stories.reason: regulatory delay reported by Cyprus Mail, Hiru News; company update

stories.headline: Defence drone and counter-drone developments: Pentagon talks with GM and Ford on drone parts, India's Bhargavastra counter-swarm system clears trials, Japan takes delivery of AI interceptor drones
stories.summary: Several defence drone items: Pentagon preliminary talks with GM and Ford on drone components, India's Bhargavastra counter-swarm system completing Pokhran trials, Japan receiving its first AI interceptor drones developed with Ukrainian technology, and the Geneva AI weapons summit producing a modest deal.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia president, CEO and board member after reported departure; Vance says he was not under investigation
stories.summary: Reports say Huang was reinstated as Nvidia president, CEO and board member, with Vance saying he was not under investigation; one aggregated item describes a resignation amid a scandal, which conflicts with the reinstatement reports.
stories.reason: Reuters coverage; conflicting aggregator item noted

stories.headline: Volvo Cars begins training Hexagon AEON humanoid robots for factory work at Ghent plant from mid-2027
stories.summary: Volvo Cars is training Hexagon humanoid robots for manufacturing work, with production introduction planned for 2027 at its Belgian plant.
stories.reason: covered by Automotive News, Cision, Motor Illustrated

stories.headline: Robotics industry announcements: Rockwell Automation to acquire AGILOX, Boston Dynamics expands GlobalFoundries partnership, Dexory launches warehouse safety module
stories.summary: Trade press reports include Rockwell Automation's acquisition of AGILOX, Boston Dynamics' expanded GlobalFoundries deal, Dexory's new warehouse module and related deployments.

stories.headline: Humanoid robots move into real-world settings: Robotera 45 robots at China Post, Xiaomi-scale humanoid trials, Toyota factory testing
stories.summary: Humanoid robots are being deployed or trialed in logistics, retail, labs and factories, including 45 Robotera units at China Post's Hangzhou hub and humanoid factory trials at Toyota.
stories.reason: PR Newswire and trade press; Nikkei Asia coverage

stories.headline: Physical AI startups raise funding: Lute raises $20M for tactile robot sensing, Genesis AI $500M Series A, Humyn Labs $47M Series A
stories.summary: Several physical AI startups announced funding rounds, including Lute's touch-sensing raise, Genesis AI's large Series A, and Humyn Labs' $47M Series A.

stories.headline: US chip curbs and distillation crackdown threaten Chinese AI development; Kazakhstan deepens AI cooperation with Russia
stories.summary: Reuters exclusive reports US chip curbs and a distillation crackdown threaten Chinese AI model development, while Kazakhstan boosts AI ties with Russia.

stories.headline: Saipem wins Equinor extension for Njord subsea drone services through 2034
stories.summary: Saipem won an extension from Equinor to provide Njord subsea drone and robotics services through 2034.

stories.headline: Robotics and AI market and sector items: RoboSense reports record LiDAR sales, Kelai Mechatronics stock surges
stories.summary: Smaller sector items include RoboSense's Q3 2026 results with robotics LiDAR ranking first globally and a surge in shares of Kelai Mechatronics.

stories.headline: RoboSense LiDAR sales surge as robotics and AI sensing expand
stories.summary: RoboSense reports rising robotics LiDAR sales and ranks first globally by volume.

stories.headline: Figure AI responds to Musk's staged-demo criticism with apology video
stories.summary: Figure AI countered Elon Musk's criticism of its robot demo with a short video showing the robot succeeding after the table was moved.

stories.headline: OpenAI tops humanoid benchmark; Tony Fadell says OpenAI needs a physical AI device
stories.summary: A humanoid benchmark reportedly placed OpenAI ahead of Google and Anthropic, and Tony Fadell commented that OpenAI needs a physical AI device.
